title: signal-extractor output: the rows of one note's ## Extracted signals

mode.description: fresh: table empty; append: new rows after the last #; repair: edits to existing rows by #

n.description: row # — required for repair, ignored for fresh/append (the engine numbers)

quote.description: the words of the cited block this row rests on, copied verbatim (no paraphrase). Required on new rows: the engine looks for it in ## Raw and flags the row [unverified] when it is absent. A repair row with n may carry a corrected quote.

scope.description: living Jira tickets (2-extraction.md § A living Jira ticket): agreed by both sides / dropped in the discussion / proposed and never answered. Rendered as a [scope:x] Notes prefix.

supersedes.description: earlier row #s on this note this row replaces (a newer description or comment). The engine writes 'supersedes #m' here and 'superseded by #n' on each earlier row; the earlier rows stay.

repaired.description: rows the self-audit corrected or added

unread_blocks.description: SRC-n ids the extractor could not read

self_audit.description: What only the extractor can know about its own pass. The engine decides whether the independent audit is owed (bigin note write-signals → audit_owed, audit_reasons); `audit_owed` here is accepted for older outputs and ignored.
